Name: unit01:translation:0
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit01", "zh": "近年来，随着互联网技术的迅猛发展，互联网经济已成为一个热门话题。", "en_reference": "In recent years, with the rapid development of Internet technology, the Internet economy has become a hot topic.", "keywords": ["recent", "years", "rapid", "development"]}

Name: unit01:translation:1
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit01", "zh": "以电子商务为代表的互联网经济已成为中国经济发展的重要引擎（driving force）。", "en_reference": "The Internet economy, represented by e-commerce, has become an important driving force for China’s economic development.", "keywords": ["Internet", "economy", "represented", "e-commerce"]}

Name: unit01:translation:2
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit01", "zh": "我国政府提出了“互联网+”的概念，以推动互联网与医疗、交通、教育、金融、公共服务等领域的结合。", "en_reference": "The Chinese government has put forward the concept of “Internet Plus” to promote the integration of the Internet with health care, transportation, education, finance, public services and other fields.", "keywords": ["Chinese", "government", "has", "put"]}

Name: unit01:translation:3
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit01", "zh": "这将为互联网经济的发展提供更多发展机遇和更广阔的发展空间。", "en_reference": "This will provide more opportunities and broader space for the development of the Internet economy.", "keywords": ["will", "provide", "more", "opportunities"]}

Name: unit02:translation:0
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit02", "zh": "中央电视台春节联欢晚会（Spring Festival Gala）自1983年举办以来，已成为中国人生活中不可缺少的文化消费品和一个重要的文化符号。", "en_reference": "Since it was first staged in 1983, the CCTV Spring Festival Gala has become an indispensable cultural product in the life of the Chinese people and an important cultural symbol.", "keywords": ["Since", "first", "staged", "CCTV"]}

Name: unit02:translation:1
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit02", "zh": "虽然众口难调，但必须承认的是，“春晚”已成为一项“新民俗”。", "en_reference": "It is hard to please everyone, but it must be admitted that the Gala has become a “new folk custom”.", "keywords": ["hard", "please", "everyone", "must"]}

Name: unit02:translation:2
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit02", "zh": "它不仅是一台晚会，更是一种仪式与象征，一种文化与标签，一种情感与寄托。", "en_reference": "It is more than a gala: it is a ritual and a symbol, a culture and a label, a bond of emotion and a source of comfort.", "keywords": ["more", "than", "gala", "ritual"]}

Name: unit02:translation:3
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit02", "zh": "随着新媒体的出现，“春晚”也在与时俱进，以满足大众日渐多样化的需求。", "en_reference": "With the rise of new media, the Gala has also kept pace with the times in order to meet the increasingly diverse needs of the public.", "keywords": ["rise", "new", "media", "Gala"]}

Name: unit03:translation:0
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit03", "zh": "丽江古城坐落在玉龙雪山（Yulong Snow Mountain）脚下，是一座风景秀丽的历史文化名城，也是我国保存完好的少数民族古城之一。随着丽江旅游业的发展，到丽江古城观光游览的中外游客日益增多。1997年12月，丽江古城申报世界文化遗产（World Cultural Heritage Site）获得成功，成为中国第一批被列入世界文化遗产名录的历史文化名城。", "en_reference": "The Old Town of Lijiang lies at the foot of Yulong Snow Mountain. A historically and culturally famous city with beautiful scenery, it is also one of the best-preserved ancient towns of ethnic minorities in China. With the development of tourism in Lijiang, an increasing number of Chinese and foreign visitors come to tour the Old Town. In December 1997, the Old Town of Lijiang succeeded in its bid for the status of a World Cultural Heritage Site, becoming one of the first group of historical and cultural cities in China to be inscribed on the World Cultural Heritage list.", "keywords": ["Old", "Town", "Lijiang", "lies"]}

Name: unit04:translation:0
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit04", "zh": "近年来，社会的发展和就业形势的变化对大学生提出了更高的要求。", "en_reference": "In recent years, social development and changes in the employment situation have placed higher demands on college students.", "keywords": ["recent", "years", "social", "development"]}

Name: unit04:translation:1
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit04", "zh": "越来越多的大学生不再局限于学习书本知识，而是利用业余时间积极投身于社会实践活动。", "en_reference": "More and more college students no longer confine themselves to book knowledge; instead, they devote their spare time to social practice activities.", "keywords": ["More", "college", "students", "no"]}

Name: unit04:translation:2
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit04", "zh": "通过社会实践活动，他们可以提高分析问题和解决问题的能力，更深入地了解社会，增强社会责任感。", "en_reference": "Through social practice activities, they can improve their ability to analyze and solve problems, gain a deeper understanding of society, and strengthen their sense of social responsibility.", "keywords": ["Through", "social", "practice", "activities"]}

Name: unit04:translation:3
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit04", "zh": "同时，参加社会实践活动还可以帮助他们认识到自身的不足，明确未来努力的方向。", "en_reference": "At the same time, participating in social practice activities can also help them recognize their own shortcomings and clarify the direction of their future efforts.", "keywords": ["same", "time", "participating", "social"]}

Name: unit05:translation:0
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit05", "zh": "实现中华民族伟大复兴是近代以来中国人民最伟大的梦想，我们称之为“中国梦”，其基本内涵是实现国家富强、民族振兴、人民幸福。", "en_reference": "To realize the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation has been the greatest dream of the Chinese people since modern times. We call it the “Chinese Dream”, whose essential meaning is to build a prosperous and strong country, to rejuvenate the nation, and to bring happiness to the people.", "keywords": ["realize", "great", "rejuvenation", "Chinese"]}

Name: unit05:translation:1
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit05", "zh": "每个中国人都是中国梦的参与者和创造者。", "en_reference": "Every Chinese is a participant in and a creator of the Chinese Dream.", "keywords": ["Every", "Chinese", "participant", "creator"]}

Name: unit05:translation:2
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit05", "zh": "我们要把自己的前途与国家的命运紧紧相连。", "en_reference": "We should link our own future closely with the destiny of our country.", "keywords": ["should", "link", "own", "future"]}

Name: unit05:translation:3
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit05", "zh": "中国梦是民族的梦，也是每个中国人的梦。", "en_reference": "The Chinese Dream is the dream of the nation, and it is also the dream of every Chinese.", "keywords": ["Chinese", "Dream", "nation", "also"]}

Name: unit05:translation:4
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit05", "zh": "我们应坚定信心、同心同德，为全面推进中华民族伟大复兴而团结奋斗。", "en_reference": "We should have firm confidence, work with one heart and one mind, and strive in unity to advance the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation in all respects.", "keywords": ["should", "have", "firm", "confidence"]}

Name: unit06:translation:0
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit06", "zh": "当前，中国实行更加积极主动的开放战略，构建面向全球的高标准自由贸易区网络，加快推进自由贸易试验区、海南自由贸易港建设。中国已成为140多个国家和地区的主要贸易伙伴，吸引外资和对外投资（outbound investment）居世界前列。未来，中国将不断推进高水平对外开放，提升贸易投资合作质量和水平，加快建设贸易强国。", "en_reference": "At present, China is pursuing a more proactive opening-up strategy, building a global network of high-standard free trade areas, and stepping up the development of pilot free trade zones and the Hainan Free Trade Port. China has become a major trading partner of more than 140 countries and regions, and ranks among the world’s leaders in both attracting foreign investment and making outbound investment. In the future, China will continue to advance high-standard opening-up, improve the quality and level of trade and investment cooperation, and move faster to build itself into a strong trading nation.", "keywords": ["present", "China", "pursuing", "more"]}
